name: url-shortener-greenfield
requirement: Build a URL-shortener service: create short links from valid HTTP(S) destination URLs, redirect a short code to its destination, persist links in SQLite, record a click count per link, expose a health endpoint and a basic analytics endpoint, validate destination URLs are HTTP(S), and return a clear error for unknown short codes.
acceptance_criteria: POST a valid HTTP(S) URL and receive a short code plus the full short link
GET the short link and receive an HTTP redirect to the original destination
Each redirect increments a persisted click count for that short code
GET an analytics endpoint for a short code returns its destination and click count
GET a health endpoint returns a 200 status when the service is reachable
POST a non-HTTP(S) or malformed URL is rejected with a 4xx response and an explanatory error message
GET an unknown short code returns a 404 response rather than a redirect
Links persist across service restarts via the SQLite database file
